mapper.insert: insert into pcd_user_quota_table (quota_id, quota_user_id, quota_total_capacity, quota_used_capacity, quota_file_count, quota_version) values(#{id}, #{user_id}, #{total_capacity}, #{used_capacity}, #{file_count}, #{version});

update pcd_user_quota_table set quota_total_capacity=#{total_capacity} where quota_user_id=#{user_id};
update pcd_user_quota_table set quota_used_capacity=#{used_capacity} where quota_user_id=#{user_id};
